metaKeys.description: Equipment/content tier from 1 to 5. Used for authoring, filtering and campaign placement; it does not directly add statistics.

Which disciplines can PRODUCE this item. Ingredients are ungated -- this does not restrict what the item may be used to make. Absent means the default from disciplineDefaults, so only exceptions are authored. An item may belong to several; overlap is how a thin discipline is furnished without new content.

The one admitted crafting override. Intensity is derived from cost; a grade multiplies it, recording where the author disagrees with the price (a rare herb that costs nothing and does a lot). Enumerated and multiplicative on purpose -- an absolute field would fork the number and drift the way the old meta.potency did.
Set false to keep an item out of Item Creation entirely (quest and key items). Opt-out, because signatures are derived and every item otherwise acquires one.

Set false to keep an item out of Item Creation INGREDIENT selection. Independent of `craftable`, which only excludes outputs: monster remains are ingredients that are never produced (craftable false, craftIngredient absent), while a promotion key is neither (both false). Opt-out for the same reason craftable is.
When true, field-item usability rejects the item on safe maps before it can be consumed. Used by traversal tools such as Town Portal.
Marks this event/cell as detectable: "trap" (checked against SEE_TRAPS) or "secret" (SEE_WALLS). Affects perception only -- a trap is still an ordinary event.
Difficulty of noticing this (default 1). The party's best sense rate must be >= this value.

disciplines.label: Alchemy

commands.label: Recruit Monster
commands.description: Triggers dynamic creature recruitment for the floor or specified actor.

commands.label: Show Text
commands.description: Shows a dialogue line and waits for input. Expression selects the 1-5 portrait-sheet column; column 1 is the default.

commands.label: Show Choice
commands.description: Presents options; each option carries its own command list. Optional cancelOption is a one-based authored option triggered by Cancel.

commands.label: Conditional Branch
commands.description: Branches on a flag:/hasItem: condition string.

commands.label: Recover Party
commands.description: Fully restores the party and shows the recovery line.

commands.label: Open Shop
commands.description: Opens the shop scene stocked from data/shops.json for the given shop id.

commands.label: Offer Quest
commands.description: Marks a quest active (quest:<id>:active flag) and runs the quest.offer flow (or the quest's acceptHook, if it has one).

commands.label: Complete Quest
commands.description: Runs the quest.complete flow (or the quest's completeHook): takes item requirements and grants rewards, then marks the quest completed (quest:<id>:completed flag).

commands.label: Start Battle
commands.description: Starts a battle and resumes the event afterwards. `troop` names a troop to fight; without one the current map's encounter table is rolled. `onVictory` and `onDefeat` are command lists run after the fight, both rejoining whatever follows the BATTLE.

commands.label: Call Common Event
commands.description: Runs a common event's commands inline.

commands.label: Label
commands.description: Marks a jump target for JUMP_TO_LABEL elsewhere in this event/common event's command list. No effect on its own.

commands.label: Jump to Label
commands.description: Unconditionally jumps to the matching LABEL anywhere in this same event/common event (including inside other CHOICE options or branches). Does not cross CALL_COMMON_EVENT boundaries.

commands.label: Comment
commands.description: Documentation only; the interpreter skips it entirely.

commands.label: Control Variables
commands.description: Sets one or several flow-local variables, readable as v.name in formulas. Single form: name + value. Multi form: assignments rows, evaluated in order so later values can read earlier ones via v. — when assignments is present, name/value are ignored.

commands.label: Mutate Tile
commands.description: Change a map cell's structure at runtime (e.g. reveal a hidden passage: wall -> floor).

commands.label: Set Flag
commands.description: Sets or clears a session flag (the same flags conditions read).

commands.label: Unlock Lore
commands.description: Permanently unlocks an authored data/lore.json entry in the current session.

commands.label: Set Map Presentation
commands.description: Persistently changes a map's tileset, fog preset, and ambient RGB, immediately rebaking live lighting. The override survives transfers and save/load.

commands.label: Enter Illustrated Location
commands.description: Uses a static assets/locationArt image behind the current event's dialogue until the conversation returns to the map.

commands.label: Change Event Properties
commands.description: Changes event properties such as label or name at runtime, with optional save file persistence.

commands.label: Set Event Label
commands.description: Changes an event's display label at runtime.

commands.label: Set Event Name
commands.description: Changes an event's name at runtime.

commands.label: If
commands.description: Runs then/else on a formula condition; flag:/hasItem: strings stay valid.

commands.label: For Each
commands.description: Iterates enemies, living_enemies, allies, living_allies, party, or slot_allies (living battlers in battle slots 1-4, matching the legacy per-slot loops).

commands.label: Gain Gold
commands.description: Adds floor(amount) gold to the party, clamped at 0.

commands.label: Grant XP
commands.description: Grants XP through the normal level-up pipeline.

commands.label: Damage
commands.description: Deals damage via effects.apply so death/log events stay consistent. pierce skips DEF/element scaling and minHp floors HP without killing (legacy-exact raw damage).

commands.label: Heal
commands.description: Heals via effects.apply, capped at max HP. With a trait code, heals silently by the target's rate for that trait (absorbed TRAIT_HEAL).

commands.label: Add State
commands.description: Adds a state through the status pipeline.

commands.label: Remove State
commands.description: Removes a state through the status pipeline.

commands.label: Change MP
commands.description: Changes the shared MP pool by a signed amount.

commands.label: State Ticks
commands.description: Runs the regen/poison/duration-decay block for all battlers.

commands.label: Tick Skill Timers
commands.description: Counts down one round on every battler's skill cooldowns and warmups. Battle-scoped: these timers are cleared when a battle starts and never enter a save, unlike spell charges.

commands.label: Emit Text
commands.description: Emits a battle-log/text event via formatTerm.

commands.label: Change Item
commands.description: Gives or takes items by a signed count.

commands.label: Use Item
commands.description: Applies an item's data-defined effects and consumes one. itemIndex is 1-based into the id-sorted inventory (the window renderer's 'inventory' list order); items with target 'party' hit every member, otherwise target is a party index.

commands.label: Equip Item
commands.description: Equips gear on a party member. slot: 1=Weapon 2=Armor 3=Accessory; target is a party index; itemIndex is 1-based into the window renderer's 'equipment' list order (1 = unequip, then matching inventory gear id-ascending). Previous gear returns to the inventory.

commands.label: Reap Fallen Spirits
commands.description: Permadeath sweep: removes every party spirit still dead (plus emergency-wave casualties) and banks their EXP at the sacrifice rate. Meant for battle.victory / battle.escaped.

commands.label: Roll Encounter
commands.description: Rolls math.random() < chance; on success emits an encounter event the map host consumes.

commands.label: Spawn Enemies
commands.description: Builds a troop and emits a spawn_enemies event with it. Uses the authored `troop` if given, else the one the caller named (BATTLE passes its own down), else a weighted roll over the map's encounter table. Counts and levels belong to the troop's member slots.

commands.label: Run Troop Events
commands.description: Runs the current troop's battle events declared for this phase (battle_start, round_start, after_action, round_end), base troop first. Each event fires when its `when` formula holds; `once` spends it for the rest of the battle. Troop events run from inside the phase flows rather than a second loop, so a battle has one place its logic happens.

commands.label: Emit Raw Event
commands.description: Emits a raw event of the given type (e.g. flee_success) for the host loop to consume.

commands.label: Emit Text
commands.description: Emits text event using terms.

commands.label: Scene Event
commands.description: Emits a scene_change event that scene_host consumes; the interpreter never switches scenes itself. Optional vars ({name, value} rows, evaluated against the pushing scene right now) are applied to the pushed scene's v right after its own on_enter runs, e.g. to hand it a chosen party member index.

commands.label: Fall Through to Legacy Input
commands.description: Marks this hook invocation as unhandled so the legacy input underneath it runs instead (e.g. map movement on up/down/left/right when no menu overlay is open). Any hook key otherwise intercepts its key unconditionally.

commands.label: Load Map
commands.description: Loads or restores a map. Dangerous floors persist after first generation. arrival selects the landmark beside which the player appears: entrance when descending, exit when climbing, resume for exact saved position.

commands.label: Open Town Portal
commands.description: Stores the current dungeon map and exact position, then temporarily returns to the safe map. Fails loudly if used outside a dungeon.

commands.label: Return Through Town Portal
commands.description: Returns to the exact dungeon tile stored by PORTAL_TO_TOWN, then closes the portal. Fails loudly when no portal is open.

commands.label: Quit Game
commands.description: Quits the game (title Exit).

commands.label: Reset Session
commands.description: Discards the current session and starts a fresh one with the starting party (game over / new game). Optional developerMode overrides the launch default for the new session.

commands.label: List Campaigns
commands.description: Fills v.campaignRows (rows: name = display title, campaign = dir name, empty = default data/) and v.campaignCount from the available campaign roots (title campaign picker).

commands.label: Switch Campaign
commands.description: Switches the active campaign root to campaigns/<name> (empty name = default data/), reloads loader/config, and persists the campaign.json pointer. Follow with RESET_SESSION + re-enter the scene.

commands.label: List Save Slots
commands.description: Fills v.saveRows (rows: name = display label, slot = slot id, empty = true if unused) and v.saveCount from a fixed set of save slots (default 3, override with count). Used by the Save/Load menus.

commands.label: Save Game
commands.description: Saves the current session into the given slot (default 'slot1'). Records the scene BELOW this one on the stack, so Save must be reached by pushing on top of town/map (same restriction as F5 quicksave).

commands.label: Load Game
commands.description: Loads the given slot, rebuilds the session, and transitions to the scene it was saved from. Sets v.loadError if the slot can't be read.

commands.label: List Active Quests
commands.description: Fills v.questRows (rows: name, id, summary, objectives, completed) and v.questCount from quests the session has active or completed (session.flags quest:<id>:active/:completed). Quest-level only, no per-objective tracking.

commands.label: List Unlocked Lore
commands.description: Fills v.loreRows (rows: id, name, title, category, body) and v.loreCount from baseline and session-unlocked lore entries.

commands.label: List Input Bindings
commands.description: Fills v.bindingRows (rows: name = 'BUTTON - key', button, key) and v.bindingCount from engine.input_map's current SNES-button->key bindings, in a fixed button order. Used by the Controls scene.

commands.label: Set Input Binding
commands.description: Rebinds the given SNES button (A/B/X/Y/L/R/START/SELECT/UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) to the given LOVE key name via engine.input_map, persisting to data/input.json. No-op if the button name is unknown.

commands.label: Script Call
commands.description: Sandboxed Lua escape hatch (see scriptingHelp). Forbidden in shipped default flows and built-in scenes; allowed in extra (user-authored) scenes.

commands.label: Open Window
commands.description: Opens a UI window.

commands.label: Close Window
commands.description: Closes a UI window.

commands.label: Set List
commands.description: Binds a list source to a window. `filter` is a row formula that DROPS rows it rejects, where `priority` only sorts them first -- use it when a row must not be selectable at all (Item Creation hiding meta.craftIngredient == false). Optional row widgets: sprite = row field holding a small battler sheet key; gaugeValue/gaugeMax = row-scoped formulas drawn as a bar under each row. slot/member are draw-time formulas for the 'equipSlots' and 'equipment' sources (slot: 1=Weapon 2=Armor 3=Accessory, member: party index).

commands.label: Set Text
commands.description: Sets text in a window.

commands.label: Set Cursor
commands.description: Sets cursor position (formula for dynamic index).

commands.label: Focus Window
commands.description: Focuses a UI window.

commands.label: Play Animation
commands.description: Plays an animation.

commands.label: Wait
commands.description: Waits for a duration.

commands.label: Show String Picture
commands.description: Creates or replaces a numbered screen-space text object.

commands.label: Move String Picture
commands.description: Moves, fades, or scales an existing string picture.

commands.label: Erase String Picture
commands.description: Erases a string picture, optionally fading it first.

commands.label: Erase All String Pictures
commands.description: Immediately clears every string picture.

commands.label: Show Image Picture
commands.description: Creates or replaces a numbered screen-space bitmap object.

commands.label: Move Image Picture
commands.description: Moves, fades, scales, or rotates an existing image picture.

commands.label: Erase Image Picture
commands.description: Erases an image picture, optionally fading it first.

commands.label: Erase All Image Pictures
commands.description: Immediately clears every image picture.

commands.label: Set Subtractive Fade
commands.description: Moves the shared backdrop-only PSX subtractive fade amount; UI remains unaffected.

commands.label: Enable Event Skip
commands.description: Lets Cancel jump the active event to an authored cleanup LABEL.

commands.label: Disable Event Skip
commands.description: Disables event skipping.

commands.label: Start Common Event
commands.description: Starts a common event from a scene hook through the presentation host.

commands.label: Apply Skill/Item Effects
commands.description: Applies the acting skill or item effects to the targets.

commands.label: Take Quest Requirements
commands.description: Verifies and consumes the active quest's item requirements.

commands.label: Grant Quest Rewards
commands.description: Grants the active quest's rewards (XP, Gold, Items, Flags).

commands.label: Erase Event
commands.description: Removes the active map event from the current floor (a looted chest, a recruited creature).

commands.label: Recruit Creature
commands.description: Adds the actor to the party, or the reserve when the active slots are full.

commands.label: Transform Creature
commands.description: Changes a creature's form while keeping the creature: accumulated growth, seed, permanent gains, learned skills, name, level and history all survive; MPD, capacities, affinities and innate skills come from the new form. `actor` is a species id, or "hatch" (resolve the actor's hatchOutcomes by the instance's saved provenance), "metamorph" (deterministic nearest eligible species from eligibleFrom), or "revert" (return to the remembered origin form). `reversible` remembers the current form so a later revert can restore it -- a natively recruited creature has none and never reverts, which is the only difference between a native Kappa and a cursed one.

commands.label: Sync Trait -> State
commands.description: Adds `state` while the target has any `trait` rate, removes it otherwise. Idempotent -- makes an equipment/passive-granted trait visible through the normal state display.

commands.label: Record History
commands.description: Increments a creature's history counter (`field` by `amount`), or sets it to `value`. Which events count is decided by the flow that calls this.

commands.label: Tick Savor
commands.description: Counts one completed battle against the target's active Favorite Food Savor and clears it at zero.

effectTypes.label: HP Damage
effectTypes.description: Relative damage when `power` names an attacker stat: potency * power^2 / (power + defense), where `defense` defaults to the stat `power` is paired with (atk vs def, mat vs mdf). Elemental affinity, then criticals, then DAMAGE_RATE apply after, and the result floors at 1. Authoring `formula` INSTEAD of `power` is direct damage: the authored number lands as-is, unreduced -- that is what a trap or a poison tick is.

effectTypes.label: HP Heal
effectTypes.description: Restores formula HP, capped at max HP.

effectTypes.label: HP Drain
effectTypes.description: Resolves damage exactly as hp_damage does -- one shared implementation, so a drain can never drift from the curve -- and heals the user for what it dealt.

effectTypes.label: Add Status
effectTypes.description: Applies a state with the given chance and turn duration.

effectTypes.label: HP Restore
effectTypes.description: Restores `value` HP plus `percent` of the target's Max HP (0.25 = 25%). Either may stand alone, so one effect covers flat, percentage and hybrid recovery -- a percentage keeps a food relevant to creatures whose Max HP differ by an order of magnitude.

effectTypes.label: Max HP Up
effectTypes.description: Permanently raises max HP and heals the difference.

effectTypes.label: Teach Skill
effectTypes.description: Permanently teaches the target a skill (skillbook items). No-op with a message if already known.

effectTypes.label: Permanent Stat Up
effectTypes.description: Permanently raises the target's param (maxHp/atk/def/mat/mdf) by value. maxHp also heals by the gain.

effectTypes.label: Grant XP
effectTypes.description: Grants experience points, possibly leveling up.

effectTypes.label: MP Restore
effectTypes.description: Restores `value` MP plus `percent` of the summoner's Max MP (0.10 = 10%) to the shared pool. The percentage form is what keeps a draught meaningful as Max MP climbs.

effectTypes.label: Max MP Up
effectTypes.description: Permanently raises the summoner's Max MP by value, clamped to system.summoner.maxMpCap, and restores the same amount. Saved with the session, so it is the item-scale counterpart of the large increases major events grant.

effectTypes.label: Restore Charges
effectTypes.description: Restores `amount` spell charges to the target creature -- every skill it knows, or just the one named by `skill`. `amount: "all"` is a full refill, the same one Rest performs. Charges are per-creature and per-skill and only otherwise come back at Rest, so this is the food/restorative channel into the magic economy.

effectTypes.label: Run Common Event
effectTypes.description: Starts the common event named by `value` (the Forbidden Lamp shape: an item that opens a scripted encounter). Raised as a request rather than executed inline, because CALL_COMMON_EVENT compiles to a dialogue node and immediate mode refuses it; the host starts the graph after the current hook settles. In a headless run the request is simply unclaimed.

effectTypes.label: Remove Status
effectTypes.description: Cures the state named in value.

effectTypes.label: Recruit Egg
effectTypes.description: Recruits actor `value` into the party (reserve when the active slots are full); `level` optional. Used by hatching items like the Mystic Egg.

effectTypes.label: Escape Battle
effectTypes.description: Attempts to escape the battle, running the battle.flee_attempt flow (its odds, FLEE_CHANCE_BONUS and gold penalty). Honoured before the round is built, so a creature carrying it escapes the party rather than acting in speed order -- which is why it is declared on a skill rather than resolved in effects.apply.

traitCodes.label: Cover Aligned Back
traitCodes.description: A living, unrestricted front-row holder of this trait protects the living back-row creature in the same column from single-target coverable attacks.

traitCodes.label: Parameter +
traitCodes.description: Adds a flat amount to a parameter.

traitCodes.label: Parameter %
traitCodes.description: Multiplies a parameter (1.2 = +20%).

traitCodes.label: Hit Rate
traitCodes.description: Modifies hit chance (base 100%).

traitCodes.label: Evasion
traitCodes.description: Modifies evade chance (base 0%).

traitCodes.label: Critical Rate
traitCodes.description: Modifies crit chance (base 5%). The effective rate against a given target is CRI minus that target's CEV.

traitCodes.label: Critical Evasion
traitCodes.description: Subtracts from an attacker's CRI against this holder. Worth twice what it looks like: a critical is also the universal status backdoor (it forces the affliction attached to the action past the chance roll), so being hard to crit means less burst damage AND fewer forced states. Deliberately trait-driven only -- gear and passives buy it, no stat derives it, or DEF would become a super-stat on top of mitigation and physical-ailment resistance.

traitCodes.label: HP Regen
traitCodes.description: Regenerates a fraction of max HP per turn.

traitCodes.label: Post-Battle Heal
traitCodes.description: Restores HP to the holder after victory.

traitCodes.label: Bonus Gold
traitCodes.description: Increases gold found.

traitCodes.label: Parasite
traitCodes.description: Drains HP from a nearby ally each turn.

traitCodes.label: Ambush Damage
traitCodes.description: Damages an enemy at battle start.

traitCodes.label: Heal on Move
traitCodes.description: Restores HP when moving on the map.

traitCodes.label: Recovery XP Bonus
traitCodes.description: Bonus XP at recovery sites.

traitCodes.label: Flee Chance +
traitCodes.description: Increases the party's flee chance.

traitCodes.label: Death Ward / On-Death Trigger
traitCodes.description: Saves the creature from the end-of-battle permadeath sweep (REAP_FALLEN). mode: relic (never consumed) | charges (spends one per save, breaks at zero) | ward (consumed, creature survives) | revive (consumed, reaped then restored). Optional params: hpFraction, charges, levelCost. Defaults come from system.json permadeath.

traitCodes.label: See Traps
traitCodes.description: Detects hidden traps (value = level).

traitCodes.label: See Secrets
traitCodes.description: Reveals breakable walls.

traitCodes.label: Symbiosis
traitCodes.description: Heals a neighboring ally each turn.

traitCodes.label: Initiative
traitCodes.description: Chance to act first at battle start.

traitCodes.label: Rear Guard
traitCodes.description: Negates enemy first strikes.

traitCodes.label: Element Change
traitCodes.description: Overrides the holder's elements with dataId while active.

traitCodes.label: Element Add
traitCodes.description: Appends dataId to the holder's elements while active, deepening an existing alignment or adding a new one. Applied after ELEMENT_CHANGE.

traitCodes.label: XP Rate +
traitCodes.description: Multiplies experience gained (0.5 = +50%).

traitCodes.label: Craft Yield +
traitCodes.description: Multiplies Item Creation yield score (0.25 = +25%).

traitCodes.label: Armor Penetration
traitCodes.description: Ignores this share of the target's defending stat before the damage curve (0.3 = 30%). Adds to an effect's own `penetration` and clamps at 1. Applied to the defense rather than the damage on purpose: against a soft target it is worth almost nothing and against a wall it is worth a great deal, which is what separates it from simply hitting harder.

traitCodes.label: Execution Threshold
traitCodes.description: After the holder's damage lands, a surviving target at or below this fraction of its Max HP is finished outright (0.2 = a fifth). A finisher rather than a gamble: it is checked after the hit, so it closes a wounded enemy and does nothing to a healthy one.

traitCodes.label: Execution Resistance
traitCodes.description: Subtracts from an attacker's EXECUTION_THRESHOLD against this holder; 1.0 is outright protection (Safety Bit). Deliberately separate from state resistance -- execution is not a state, and it subtracts rather than rolling, so it costs no randomness and partial resistance means something exact.

traitCodes.label: Forced Action
traitCodes.description: The holder can only take the skill named by dataId, whatever it or the player chose. Applied where the turn queue is built, so it constrains an AI enemy and a player creature by the same rule -- Berserk forcing a basic Attack is one authored state, not a branch in the battle code. Target is picked by the forced skill's own targeting spec.

traitCodes.label: Invert Targeting
traitCodes.description: Inverts targeting groups for the holder while active (`enemy` side targets allies, `ally` side targets enemies). Used by Charm and confusion effects.

traitCodes.label: State Susceptibility %
traitCodes.description: Multiplies the chance of the state named by dataId landing on the holder (0.5 = half as likely, 1.5 = half again). A rate is a SLOPE, not a switch: driving it to 0 makes the state vanishingly unlikely on the ordinary path, but a critical hit still forces it. For 'never, not even on a crit', use STATE_IMMUNITY -- and G1 rejects a rate of 0 outright, because anyone authoring that almost certainly means immunity.

traitCodes.label: State Immunity
traitCodes.description: Absolute immunity to the state named by dataId: it never lands, including from a critical hit. Immunity is its own trait rather than a rate of zero (RPG Maker MZ's shape) so that rates can stay a slope all the way down -- a very high VIT creature is functionally unpoisonable without ever becoming categorically immune by accident -- and so 'never' is something an author states outright.

traitCodes.label: State Category Immunity
traitCodes.description: As STATE_IMMUNITY, but for every state carrying the category named by dataId. This is a Ribbon's actual spelling (`common`), replacing the old STATE_CATEGORY_RATE-of-0 idiom.

traitCodes.label: State Category %
traitCodes.description: As STATE_RATE, but for every state carrying the category named by dataId (see engine.stateCategories). One trait covers a whole family, which is how a Ribbon blocks ordinary negative states without listing them -- and why `unique` exists, so death and authored curses sit outside such a blanket. Multiplies with STATE_RATE rather than replacing it.

traitCodes.label: Status Success +
traitCodes.description: Multiplies the holder's chance of inflicting states (0.25 = +25%). The attacker's half of the infliction chain, which is what lets a control specialist be better at landing conditions without every one of its skills authoring a higher chance.

traitCodes.label: Damage Taken %
traitCodes.description: Multiplies direct HP damage taken by the holder (0.5 = half). Multiplicative across sources, unlike the additive rate traits, because two independent protections should compound rather than sum past zero. Serves Defend, barriers, protective equipment and vulnerability states alike; it does not reduce authored indirect damage such as poison ticks.

traitCodes.label: Item Effect +
traitCodes.description: Multiplies the magnitude of items used by the holder (0.5 = +50%), RPG Maker Pharmacology-style. In battle the acting creature is the user; in the field the best living party carrier supplies the rate because field item use has no separate user selection.

traitCodes.label: Healing Skill +
traitCodes.description: Adds to HP healing performed by the holder's skills (0.25 = +25%). Does not amplify items or permanent gains.

traitCodes.label: Target Rate +
traitCodes.description: Adds to the holder's weight when enemy AI randomly selects an opposing target. Base weight is 1; positive values implement Provoke.

traitCodes.label: Element Damage Taken %
traitCodes.description: Multiplies damage received from the element named by dataId (0.5 = half, 1.5 = half again). Applied after identity affinity and multiplicative across sources.

traitCodes.label: Summoner MP on Kill
traitCodes.description: Restores this flat amount of Summoner MP when the holder personally lands a killing blow, including an Execution.

dock.note: The persistent bottom dock (SPEC 1.4). One surface owned by presentation/dock.lua, NOT a scene's window: its state survives scene changes, so moving between two scenes that want the same variant animates nothing at all. Scenes pick a variant with config.dock in scenes.json; geometry per window still comes from windowLayout above. Adding a variant is a data edit. Still outside the dock: reserve_party (read by name from Lua in window_renderer's drawSwapIndicator) and status_dock (binds sel('status_party'), a SCENE window, which a variant's list cache cannot see) — both need code changes first, not just data.

windows.visible: v.combatState ~= 'levelup' and v.combatState ~= 'victory' and not (v.combatState == 'log' and (v.pendingRewardLog ~= nil or v.pendingLevelUpLog == true))

stateCategories.label: Negative
stateCategories.description: Something done TO a creature against its interests. The axis broad resistances key off.

stateCategories.label: Positive
stateCategories.description: A benefit. Kept as its own category rather than as the absence of negative, so a cleanse can strip one without touching the other.

stateCategories.label: Physical
stateCategories.description: Afflicts the body: poison, injury, exhaustion.

stateCategories.label: Magical
stateCategories.description: Arcane in origin, whatever it does.

stateCategories.label: Mental
stateCategories.description: Acts on the mind rather than the body: sleep, rage, confusion.

stateCategories.label: Common
stateCategories.description: An ordinary, commonplace affliction -- the family a broad protection is meant to cover. This is the tag a Ribbon-style blanket immunity keys off (STATE_CATEGORY_IMMUNITY common), and it is deliberately a tag a state must EARN rather than a default. Nothing is exempted by inference: death and authored one-off curses simply never carry it, so no blanket can reach them. Blanketing `negative` instead would reach them, since death is negative too.

topologies.label: Plane
topologies.description: A displaced rectangular surface: walls, floors, ceilings, doors, shallow fixtures.

topologies.label: Shell
topologies.description: One or two displaced surfaces joined around a shared silhouette.

topologies.label: Radial
topologies.description: A surface storing radius over angle and height.

roles.label: Surface fixture
roles.description: Composited into architectural albedo and height before meshing.

planeSurfaces.label: Wall
planeSurfaces.description: Stands on a wall face; local +X is depth out of the wall.

planeSurfaces.label: Floor
planeSurfaces.description: Lies on the cell floor; displacement is upward.

planeSurfaces.label: Ceiling
planeSurfaces.description: Hangs from the cell ceiling; displacement is downward.

shellModes.label: Front only
shellModes.description: One surface; a one-sided or compiler-thickened object.

shellModes.label: Mirrored depth
shellModes.description: One depth field reflected through the central plane.

shellModes.label: Front / back
shellModes.description: Independent front and rear depth fields sharing one silhouette.

layouts.description: One region covering the whole image.

layouts.label: Front/back horizontal
layouts.description: Front in the left half, back in the right half.

edgeModes.label: Stitch
edgeModes.description: Bridge front and rear contours with explicit side faces.

edgeModes.label: Pinch
edgeModes.description: Converge both depths near the silhouette into a thin edge.

edgeColors.label: Blend
edgeColors.description: Average the front and rear boundary colours.

edgeColors.label: Darkened blend
edgeColors.description: Darkened average; reinforces volume and separates the painted faces.
